title: 1. Company Setup & Organizational Data
items: Company created
Accounting Periods and posting periods open
Locations / Dimensions configured (as applicable)

title: 2. Vendor Setup
items: Vendor created
Key Fields: Vendor No., Name, Address, VAT Registration No., Vendor Posting Group, Gen. Bus. Posting Group, Payment Terms Code, Bank Account, Blocked status

title: 3. Service Master / G/L Setup
items: Service purchasing supported via G/L Account or Item purchase lines
Key Fields: Type (G/L Account / Item), Description, Unit of Measure, Gen. Prod. Posting Group, VAT Prod. Posting Group

title: 4. Dimensions & Posting Setup
items: Dimensions configured (e.g., Department, Cost Center) and enforced as required
General Posting Setup configured
VAT Posting Setup configured
G/L accounts configured for purchase expense, accruals and VAT

title: 5. Tax / VAT Setup
items: VAT Product Posting Groups and VAT Business Posting Groups configured
VAT % and calculation configured

title: 6. Purchase Order Setup
items: Purchase Order number series configured
Posting groups and default dimensions set for purchase documents

title: 7. Receipt / Service Acceptance Equivalent
items: Posted Purchase Receipt available for three-way match validation
Approval workflows configured (if used)

title: 8. Recommended Test Data
items: PO with multiple service-related lines
Posted Purchase Receipt
Invoice matches Qty Received, Unit Cost and Line Amounts
